I want to cap the bytes http.Get reads. What is the idiomatic way?

resp.Body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)

See the io.LimitReader docs.

go http
42

Wrap the body in a limit reader and read one byte more than the cap, so you can tell truncation from a short body:

body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, int64(maxBytes)+1))
if len(body) > maxBytes {
    body = body[:maxBytes]
}

Then close the body with defer resp.Body.Close().

Set client.Timeout too, or a stalled server hangs the call.
